svg.aria-label: Eight fragment rows over 200 local steps, with sync_every = 100 and fragments = 8. DiLoCo exchanges every fragment together at steps 100 and 200, a single column. Streaming DiLoCo exchanges one fragment at a time, at steps 12, 25, 37, 50, 62, 75, 87 and 100 and again 100 steps later, a staircase: each fragment is still exchanged once every 100 steps, but each exchange carries an eighth of the model.
svg.text: 100 steps between two exchanges of fragment 0
